units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 2:7:2">Y. B. Mets. II, 8ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>עביד גרמיה מחזר מ׳ ועבד וכ׳</he> he gains for himself the reputation of one returning lost objects, and makes great gains; <he>חמי ליה בירייתא מחזר מ׳ וכ׳</he> people see him return lost objects and give in his trust &c.
